text:
yara: quick flag — publish blocked by semver-bot. regen diff shown as a minor but the change looks purely formatting (prettier) in generated files.
ci-bot: build #5077 failed at publish step -> exit code 1. logs: https://ci.example.com/5077
mike: minimal snippet from generated:```diff
- export interface Foo { bar:string; }
+ export interface Foo { bar: string; }
```looks like whitespace+semicolon normalization only.
olson: oof. tools/typegen pulled in a new prettier config. formatting-only diffs should not cause semver to bump.
tara: also fyi onboarding e2e flake: our auth middleware mutates the body on retry by adding retryCount which makes test assertions fail and occasionally times out the publish gate.
mike: repro steps for regen: `./scripts/regenerate && git status --porcelain` -> shows `generated/clients/foo.ts` changed.
yara: short-term mitigation ideas: (A) add a normalization step that runs prettier on generated/ before running semver-check, (B) detection for style-only diffs (ignore punctuation/spacing), (C) make the test harness deep-clone request payloads so retries are idempotent.
olson: I'll prototype a normalization script that runs `prettier --write generated/` and then diffs the normalized output for semver analysis.
tara: taking the test fix 0min PR: deep copy payload before retry: `const bodyCopy = structuredClone(req.body)` and use bodyCopy for subsequent attempts.
mike: semver-bot: if normalization script returns only formatting changes, add `regen-only` label and skip auto-minor.
ci-bot: rerun queued: job #5078 started by tara for the test fix.
yara: I'll open PR for normalization + detection and add it to the release pipeline as a pre-check. after CI green we'll unpin the prettier bump in the release branch.
semver-bot: created issue #1340 "prettier-format-only regen causing minor bump" and linked CI logs.
tara: thanks all 10. will follow up with a quick note in the release runbook and tag owners.
